description: Verify a finished slice is actually ready to land (tests green, DoD ticked, deviation log present, STATUS=DONE) and emit a deterministic landing checklist for either direct merge-to-main or PR-shaped integration. Use when the user says "land this slice", "merge back to main", "ready to ship", "create a PR for this slice", "close out the slice", or "slice is done — what now". Use `prepare` to emit a readiness report; use `execute --mode direct` to also run the merge sequence; use `execute --mode pr` to push the branch and open the PR.
